summary.text: Christine Parshall is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Cheshire 8, in the November 3, 2026 general election; the race has no incumbent. Her career experience includes working as an educator.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Christine Parshall said she was born elsewhere but built a career and raised her family in New Hampshire, with the bulk of her career as an educator with the UNH Cooperative Extension; she said she currently works for a local Early Intervention Program.
She listed affordability, the environment and upholding democracy as her key campaign messages, and named education, public health and the public safety net as policy areas of interest.
She listed the American Federation of Teachers-NH and Planned Parenthood-NH among her endorsers.
